objectRequest.name: Picker's Hollow - brown leather work boots - male
objectRequest.description: One standalone matching PAIR of brown leather work boots, South/front view, low top-down cozy pixel-art RPG. Practical ankle-height lace-up boots with stout rounded reinforced toes, dark charcoal rubber soles, small muted tan lace marks and restrained leather scuff clusters. Warm medium-dark brown, NOT orange or gold. Same everyday workshop/salvage safety boot design for both body variants; broad practical male foot shape. Sized visually for a50-pixel-tall human; each boot around7-8 pixels wide and9-10 pixels tall at native game scale. Place the pair side by side with a gap, within transparent48x64 canvas; no rescaling the pixel grid. Clear recognizable soles and toe shading using few coherent pixels. No body, legs, skin, jeans, mannequin, hanger, scenery, floor or cast shadow. Design reference only; final art will be fitted separately to exact body feet.
